svg.title: The shadowlap dashboard, from a failed run to its fix: the call blame found, the fix and its proof
svg.desc: Runs › Failed lists one issue, issue_refund called with amount 240: three runs, each lost at model call #5. The newest opens at that call, where blame found the run lost, and asked again the model escalates instead. Open fix shows the fix: blame, repair’s prompt change and verify’s verdict, every failing run fixed and every good run kept. Show patch shows the prompt change.
